rounds.text: India Cements Capital Ltd is undergoing a structural operational turnaround, evidenced by compounded sales growth accelerating to 16% over the last five years [E14], which directly underpins the screening signal that earnings growth is accelerating [E57]. Furthermore, the market capitalization stands at a modest ₹ 53.6 Cr [E2], positioning the firm as a micro-cap with substantial leverage to its improving operational trajectory. The stock is currently trading at the absolute peak of its 52-week range at ₹ 24.7 against a book value of ₹ 8.25 [E1, E4], reflecting strong, unyielding buying momentum and market conviction in its recovery phase. Conceded: [E3].
